title: Good initiative for work teams and team bulding
text: A great experience to gather work teams, keep us together and learn from the city. The guide is very funny and adapted the tour to our team.
author: japrib2024

title: Exceeded all our expectations
text: It was a unique and fun experience in the Gothic Quarter. The guide was very organized, genuine and cleared all our doubts. I recommend it 100% to families and all ages! If you have the opportunity to go, don't stop, it's worth 10/10
author: andreavcastejon

title: Best tour I've ever been on
text: Amazing tour, a mix of history, comedy and great creativity. I want to bring my friends next time. Love it!
author: dianasB4312XZ

title: Exceeded my expectations
text: I discovered the Gothic Quarter in a different and original way through augmented reality. The augmented reality application was very complete, fun and dynamic and thanks to that the tour was very entertaining. The guide was super friendly and we were not bored. I'd do it again! I've never been on a tour like it before and I've done tours all over Europe.
author: marcolsm

title: Beyond explanations
text: I loved the experience, with technology, not the simple tour that tells you the story and end, plus its touches of humor
author: 397rosaliam

title: Good tour with AR
text: A very good experience! The tour takes you back to the past with the help of Augmented Reality. The guides are very friendly and make everything interesting and fun. Perfect to discover Barcelona in a different way.
author: S810UTmaxb

title: Loved it, very funny and informative
text:
It was a super fun tour! Highly recommended to go with friends or family. 

It allows you to know stories of the Gothic Quarter in a super interactive context. 

Our guide was very attentive throughout and the app has many visual tools that helped improve our experience.

title: Excellent experience!
text: Very fun and interesting! The guide makes the tour very inclusive and keeps you hooked with jokes and curious facts

title: Highly recommended. Fun and culture assured!
